response:
I hear how exhausting and discouraging it's been to search for relief and not find it yet. That doesn't mean nothing will ever work—it means you haven't found the right fit, and you deserve to keep looking. Years of struggling with self-harm is a heavy burden, and your frustration with feeling stuck is completely valid.

Please consider reaching out to a crisis line like the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (call or text 988) or the Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741). These services are free, confidential, and available right now. You don't have to be at a breaking point to use them—they're there for moments exactly like this. Sometimes different therapy approaches (like DBT, which specifically targets self-harm) or a different therapist can make a difference when previous ones haven't. You don't have to figure this out alone, and it's okay to ask for help again even when past attempts felt like dead ends. Your safety matters, and you are worth continuing to try.
